items.t: What’s next for issuers after Fiserv cuts a debit network
items.sum: Fiserv CEO Taki Georgakopoulos said at Citi’s Fintech Conference that the technology company was consolidating its debit networks with the intent to sell or wind down the other. It’s a move that could have lasting implications on the debit card issuers and meaningfully shake up debit card routing dynamics.

items.t: Baird Maintains Outperform on Fiserv, Raises Price Target to $85
items.sum: Baird analyst David Koning maintains Fiserv (NASDAQ:FISV) with a Outperform and raises the price target from $70 to $85.
